overview: A momentary 'More' (overflow / ellipsis) button that surfaces secondary in-session actions. On tap it builds and presents a context-sensitive bottom action sheet (CustomActionSheet) whose items depend on live SDK-derived state at tap time: always Settings, conditionally recording controls (when ZMRecordingManager.shared.canControlRecording), conditionally share pause/resume (when ZMShareManager.shared.isSharing), plus Cancel. Start and Stop recording route through confirmation alerts; pause/resume of recording and sharing execute immediately. Has no persistent visual state machine and does not observe SDK events.
differenceFromAudioBtn: Unlike ZMUIToolkitAudioBtn, this button is NOT a ZoomVideoSDKDelegate, does not register/remove itself from ZMUIToolKitManager.videoSDKDelegate, and reads SDK-derived state on demand (at tap time via ZMRecordingManager/ZMShareManager singletons) rather than continuously syncing. Note: ZMRecordingManager.shared is itself a ZoomVideoSDKDelegate that drives recording-consent dialogs and toasts; the button only invokes its control methods.

typeDefinitions.name: ZoomVideoSDKError
typeDefinitions.notes: Return type of the control methods. .Errors_Success indicates success; .Errors_Wrong_Usage returned when the relevant SDK helper is nil. To respond to outcomes, observe SDK events via ZMUIToolKitManager.videoSDKDelegate.add(_:).

prerequisites: Zoom Video SDK initialized and registered with the toolkit via ZMUIToolKitManager.initialize(videoSDK:bundleId:) before the button is tapped.
(Optional) Set ZMUIToolkitStrings.stringsBundle to localize menu/dialog text.
Construct and use on the main thread (@MainActor).
lifecycle.ifNotInitialized: If ZMUIToolKitManager.videoSDK is nil, the manager helpers resolve to nil: canControlRecording is false and isSharing is false, so only Settings (and Cancel) appear; a control method called with a nil helper returns .Errors_Wrong_Usage.

actions: build descriptor (40x40, clear bg, Ellipsis icon, secondaryLabel icon color, zero padding)

exitPoints.note: No custom deinit. BottomPanelPresenter weakly references the presented panel VC.

lifecycle.delegateModel: None. The button does not observe SDK events; it reads SDK-derived state imperatively at tap time via ZMRecordingManager.shared and ZMShareManager.shared. ZMRecordingManager itself is a ZoomVideoSDKDelegate (for consent dialogs/toasts), but that is independent of this button.

states.description: Single visual state. The button does not maintain a persistent state machine; the icon is fixed (Ellipsis, clear background). The action sheet contents are recomputed from live state on each tap.

actionSheetDecisionTree.description: Decision tree evaluated fresh on each tap inside showMoreActionSheet(). Items appended in fixed order: Settings, recording control(s), share control. Cancel is rendered separately by CustomActionSheet.
actionSheetDecisionTree.settingsPanelToggle: showSettingsPanel(): if presenter.isPresented -> dismiss; else present ZMUIToolkitSettingsPanel. The panel's onStatisticsTapped dismisses settings and, after a 0.3s DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter delay, presents ZMUIToolkitQoSPanel.
actionSheetDecisionTree.confirmations: Start and Stop recording route through CustomUIAlertController confirmation alerts (inset button layout). Pause/resume of recording and sharing execute immediately with no confirmation.

apis.name: init
apis.description: Builds the button (40x40, clear background, Ellipsis icon, secondaryLabel icon color, zero padding) and installs the tap callback that presents the More action sheet via showMoreActionSheet(). Constructs the BottomPanelPresenter.
preconditions: Toolkit initialized via ZMUIToolKitManager.initialize (for functional taps)
sideEffects: None beyond super.init; no delegate registration

apis.name: init(coder:)
apis.description: NOT SUPPORTED. Calls fatalError. Do not instantiate from Storyboard/XIB.

apis.name: setMoreIcon
apis.description: Replaces the button's icon immediately via setImage(image, for: .normal). Single visual state.

apis.name: showMoreActionSheet
apis.description: Builds the [CustomActionSheet.Action] array from live state (always adds Settings; conditionally adds recording controls when ZMRecordingManager.shared.canControlRecording, and share controls when ZMShareManager.shared.isSharing) and presents a CustomActionSheet from UIApplication.topViewController() with cancel title cancelText.
preconditions: A presentable top view controller exists

apis.name: showStartRecordingAlert
apis.description: Presents a CustomUIAlertController (inset layout) with start_recording_alert_title/start_recording_alert_message, a Cancel action (no handler) and a Start action (.default) that calls ZMRecordingManager.shared.startRecording().
preconditions: A presentable top view controller exists
sideEffects: Presents a confirmation alert; on confirm calls ZMRecordingManager.shared.startRecording()

apis.name: showStopRecordingAlert
apis.description: Presents a CustomUIAlertController (inset layout) with stop_recording_alert_title/stop_recording_alert_message, a Cancel action and a Stop action (.default) that calls ZMRecordingManager.shared.stopRecording().
preconditions: A presentable top view controller exists
sideEffects: Presents a confirmation alert; on confirm calls ZMRecordingManager.shared.stopRecording()

apis.name: showSettingsPanel
apis.description: Toggles the settings bottom panel via BottomPanelPresenter: dismisses if presenter.isPresented; otherwise presents a ZMUIToolkitSettingsPanel and wires its onStatisticsTapped to dismiss settings and (after a 0.3s delay) present a ZMUIToolkitQoSPanel.
sideEffects: Presents or dismisses a bottom panel; may schedule a delayed QoS panel presentation

managerMethodsInvoked.description: Not methods of ZMUIToolkitMoreBtn; these are the singleton entry points the action items call. These methods return ZoomVideoSDKError; to respond to outcomes, observe SDK events via ZMUIToolKitManager.videoSDKDelegate.add(_:).

methods.notes: Returns early if canStartRecording() != .Errors_Success. Sets internal didInitiateRecording flag on success so the initiator skips the consent dialog.

stateQueries.gates: Whether any recording item is shown
Whether any share item is shown

stateQueries.definition: local user's share action list contains a .pause status

callbacks.note: This button implements no SDK delegate callbacks. It interacts with the SDK indirectly (through ZMRecordingManager / ZMShareManager) at the moment of user interaction. Recording-consent prompts are owned by ZMRecordingManager's own ZoomVideoSDKDelegate implementation (onCloudRecordingStatus), not by this button.

internalUICallbacks.name: tap callback
internalUICallbacks.description: Builds and presents the action sheet via showMoreActionSheet().

internalUICallbacks.name: CustomActionSheet.Action.handler
internalUICallbacks.description: Runs after the sheet dismisses (recording/share control closures, or showStart/StopRecordingAlert() / showSettingsPanel()).

internalUICallbacks.name: ZMUIToolkitSettingsPanel.onStatisticsTapped
internalUICallbacks.description: Dismisses settings, then presents the QoS panel after a 0.3s delay.

localizedStrings.customization: Set ZMUIToolkitStrings.stringsBundle and provide a ZMUIToolkit.strings table.

keys.usedFor: Action sheet cancel + alert cancel buttons

keys.default: After the recording starts, all participants will be informed and the meeting audio, video and shared screen view will be recorded to the cloud.
You will receive an email notification when the cloud recording is ready.

errorHandling.strategy: startRecording(), stopRecording(), pauseRecording(), resumeRecording(), pauseShare(), and resumeShare() return ZoomVideoSDKError. To respond to outcomes, observe SDK events via ZMUIToolKitManager.videoSDKDelegate.add(_:).
errorHandling.ifNotInitialized: ZMUIToolKitManager.videoSDK is nil -> manager helpers resolve to nil -> canControlRecording false and isSharing false (only Settings + Cancel appear); a control method with a nil helper returns .Errors_Wrong_Usage.
errorHandling.ifNoTopViewController: Action sheet and alerts present from UIApplication.topViewController(); presentation requires a presentable top view controller.
errorHandling.startRecordingGate: ZMRecordingManager.startRecording() internally calls canStartRecording() and proceeds to startCloudRecording() only when it returns .Errors_Success.
recoveryActions: Integrators should observe the SDK directly (e.g. onCloudRecordingStatus, share status callbacks) via their own ZoomVideoSDKDelegate registered with ZMUIToolKitManager.videoSDKDelegate.add(_:).

required: Initialize the toolkit (ZMUIToolKitManager.initialize) before the button is tapped for functional recording/share behavior.
Construct and use the button on the main thread.
forbidden: Instantiating via init?(coder:) / Interface Builder (traps with fatalError).
notes: The button reads SDK-derived state at tap time only (via ZMRecordingManager/ZMShareManager); it does not observe SDK events.
Recording controls only appear when canControlRecording is true; share controls only when isSharing is true.
Start and Stop recording are gated behind confirmation alerts; pause/resume of recording and sharing are immediate.
Presentation uses UIApplication.topViewController(); ensure a presentable top view controller exists when tapped.
